gearscope.attributes.title: Attributes
gearscope.configuration.closeContainersW: The Gearscope key also closes other container screens (chests, furnaces, backpacks ...), like the vanilla inventory key does. Useful if Gearscope is bound to E and the vanilla inventory to another key.
gearscope.configuration.ignoreWildcardIt: Ignore wildcard items for unused slots
Items that fit into every slot type (accessories:any) do not make a slot type count as used, so slot types without a real item stay hidden. Slots that hold an item are always shown.
gearscope.effects.title: Effects
gearscope.configuration.display.tooltip: Where active effects are shown: tiles above the frame (TOP, falls back to the tabs if there is not enough room), a group in the attribute scroll, tabs in the attribute scroll, or not at all.
